prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that on June 14th you were observed using the metric system. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman and members of the Committee, I thank you for the opportunity to address these allegations directly.

I stand before you today as a patriot who loves his country and its traditions. Let me state for the record, unequivocally, that the charge of my "using the metric system" is a gross mischaracterization born from a fundamental misunderstanding of the events of June 14th.

On the day in question, I did not engage in a systematic, ideological adoption of foreign measurements. My actions were, at worst, a temporary and purely pragmatic interaction with a foreign object. I was assembling a piece of flat-pack furniture, which, unbeknownst to me at the time of purchase, was of Scandinavian origin and came with an Allen wrench sized in millimeters. My use of that 5-millimeter tool was not an endorsement of the meter, the liter, or the gram. It was an act of domestic necessity, a surrender not to a foreign power, but to the universal tyranny of confusing assembly instructions.

To be perfectly clear, my heart beats in inches, feet, and yards. I believe a man's character is measured in pounds of pressure per square inch. I know that a 72-degree room is comfortable and a 100-degree day is a trial of American fortitude. A 2-liter bottle of soda in my refrigerator is a constant, unwelcome reminder of foreign encroachment, and I look upon it with suspicion every time I open the door.

The allegation conflates a moment of technical compliance with a deeply held conviction. My loyalty to the inch and the Fahrenheit degree is absolute and unshakeable. I am prepared to name names of other, truly subversive elements who have been advocating for a decimal-based system, and I will cooperate fully to root out this pernicious ideology. I stand ready to prove my innocence, perhaps by measuring the distance from this table to your chair in feet, a feat I can perform with my own two American feet.
